name: robots/iit-dlslab__gym-quadruped
title: gym-quadruped MuJoCo quadruped locomotion environment
intro: gym-quadruped MuJoCo quadruped locomotion environment, adapted from iit-dlslab/gym-quadruped. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
